criteria.text: Cloud identity is resolved to a local user through an immutable `google_sub` binding rather than numeric identifier equality.
criteria.test_id: issue-1230-c1: a numeric collision resolves by Google subject

criteria.text: Existing immutable bindings reject a mismatched subject or email instead of silently rebinding.
criteria.test_id: issue-1230-c2: mismatched immutable identity is rejected

criteria.text: Pairing and gateway ownership persist the resolved local user identifier only.
criteria.test_id: issue-1230-c3: pairing ownership uses the resolved local identifier

criteria.text: Automated collision tests prove that equal cloud/local numeric IDs do not authorize the wrong user and that valid bound users still pair successfully.
criteria.test_id: issue-1230-c4: valid immutable bindings continue to authenticate
